title: SDG Report 2026: Progress Made, But Fast Enough?
discussion_signal: The post juxtaposes severe poverty, aid decline, financing gaps, and heat with gains in social protection, renewable capacity, ocean protection, and disaster mortality. It makes uneven progress legible as a question of public-system capacity and coordinated action rather than a simple success/failure story.
linked_research_question: Which public systems convert coordination and investment into measurable gains, and where do compounding shocks overwhelm that capacity?
limits: The post does not provide a full methodology or country comparison
